reviews.review: Good enough game that suffers from more or less the same issues as Dead Cells. If you like Dead Cells, you'll probably like this game. If you don't like Dead Cells, it's still decent.

Very fun and not overly complicated. Absolutely love multiplayer!! The art style is pleasing to the eye, the sound design and music is a 10/10 for me too. The mechanics are interesting and dont feel clunky. Great game!
Hands down the best game I have bought in the last 18 Mo.
